exportShareDesc: Share your roster with other apps (Google Drive, WhatsApp, email, etc.). The .md file includes all unit data and can be re-imported into the app.
importDesc: Load a warband from a .md roster file or paste the JSON data directly.
terrainDesc: Auto-generate a balanced terrain layout for your battlefield.
tacticalDesc: Analyse your warband — advantages, disadvantages and tactical focus.
battleDesc: Full-screen read-only combat reference with all unit stats at a glance.
shareLinkDesc: Copies a shareable URL to clipboard — anyone can open it to load your warband.
rulesDesc: Searchable rules and keyword glossary for quick look-ups during a game.
campaignDesc: Track campaign games, exploration, resources and skills.
